purpose: Complete one sub-million-cell A/C03 measurement canary within the verified 13 GB WSL cap without weakening host safety.

measured_attempt02.interpretation: The solver was progressing when the unchanged watchdog performed a controlled host-memory stop. This is not a mesh verdict.

source_evidence.documentation: ADflow describes ILU fill 1 as typical for easy cases and up to 3 for difficult cases; more fill strengthens the linear preconditioner but costs more memory per iteration.

unchanged: mission-authority alpha, Mach, Reynolds, and temperature
steady RANS equations and SA turbulence model
nonlinear residual equations and convergence policy
surface and complete native history retention
13 GB WSL cap and 8 GB configured swap
decision.numerical_effect: The approximate linear preconditioner and linear-iteration path may change. The converged nonlinear RANS/SA fixed point does not change.

forecast_basis.classification: bounded engineering hypothesis, not a measured guarantee
forecast_basis.reason: A 0.4814 GiB reduction is required. ILU factor storage is one of the dominant allocated structures, and ADflow explicitly identifies fill as a memory lever. Exact mesh-specific fill-factor savings cannot be known without launching the governed solve, so the unchanged watchdog remains the terminal authority.
forecast_basis.failure_semantics: If the forecast is exceeded or the watchdog fires, record a resource outcome and do not retry.

alternatives.name: reduce_ank_and_nk_ilu_fill_2_to_1
alternatives.reason: Direct documented memory lever that changes only the approximate linear preconditioner. Applying it to both phases prevents NK from restoring fill 2 later.

alternatives.name: disable_full_viscous_ank_preconditioner_terms
alternatives.reason: Also changes the approximate Jacobian stencil and could save memory, but is a broader preconditioner change than lowering fill.

alternatives.name: raise_wsl_cap_above_13_gb
alternatives.reason: The 16 GB physical host would retain less Windows margin and prior abrupt WSL shutdowns make this inferior to solver-side memory reduction.

alternatives.name: lower_watchdog_floor_or_rely_on_swap
alternatives.reason: Would weaken host safety and does not reduce the solver working set.

alternatives.name: substitute_C02
alternatives.reason: Would not answer whether the required sub-million C03 measurement can execute on this desktop.

invalidation_triggers: mesh, cell count, flow point, equations, turbulence model, precision, rank count, or solver-library identity changes
ANKSubspaceSize, NKSubspaceSize, ANKPCILUFill, or NKPCILUFill differs from 10, 20, 1, 1
prelaunch forecast plus 2 GiB exceeds live MemAvailable
independent review returns any HIGH finding
